test_title: PYST 02: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 10 Dec 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the phrase/idiom that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

Our defence minister has shown his __silver will__ by introducing this scheme.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **iron will**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"iron will"** means a strong, determined, and unyielding willpower. (लोहे की तरह मजबूत इच्छाशक्ति)

 
 
• **Example: **Despite numerous setbacks, she pursued her goals with an iron will.
 
 
 
• **"silver will"** is not a commonly used idiom or phrase in English, and hence does not convey any specific meaning. 
 
 
• **Example: **His silver will was evident in his actions. (Incorrect usage)
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **iron will**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Diamond will** (हीरे जैसी इच्छाशक्ति): Not a commonly used idiom in English.

 
 
• **Example:** His diamond will led him to succeed. (Incorrect usage)
 
 
 
• **Stony will** (पत्थर जैसी इच्छाशक्ति): Not a commonly used idiom in English.
 
 
• **Example:** She faced all challenges with a stony will. (Incorrect usage)
 
 
 
• **Golden will** (सोने जैसी इच्छाशक्ति): Not a commonly used idiom in English.
 
 
• **Example:** His golden will was appreciated by everyone. (Incorrect usage)
 
 

6e:T746,
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
